summary: Prachak Roasted Duck is a long-running Bang Rak shop-house restaurant on Charoen Krung Road, known for roast duck with rice or noodles and other Chinese-Thai roast meats. It suits a straightforward, casual meal near the river and Saphan Taksin BTS.
whyGo: The Tourism Authority of Thailand directory describes it as operating since 1909 and highlights roast duck, red pork and crispy pork.
Choose duck over rice or noodles for a direct taste of the house specialty; the menu also offers roast meats and simple snacks.
Its Charoen Krung location makes it easy to pair with a Bang Rak or riverside walk.
bestFor: A quick, informal lunch or early dinner focused on roast duck
Travelers exploring Bang Rak and the Charoen Krung riverfront
People comfortable with a busy, compact local restaurant
skipIf: You need a verified step-free route or wheelchair-accessible dining setup
You are vegetarian or require confirmed allergy and cross-contact procedures
You want an elaborate or quiet fine-dining meal
duration: Allow about 30–60 minutes for a meal; this is a planning estimate and waiting time can vary.
cost: Budget roughly THB 80–150 per person for a single rice or noodle dish, as a planning estimate based on recent menu listings and customer examples; ordering duck by the portion or adding sides will cost more. Confirm current prices on the posted menu. Older directory listings quote a wider THB 101–300 range.
hours: Recent listings show daily service around 08:00–20:30. Hours vary slightly between directories; confirm directly before travelling, especially on public holidays.
bestTime: Go before the late lunch or dinner rush, and earlier in the day if you want the best chance of finding the full selection. Popular items may sell out.
gettingThere: At 1415 Charoen Krung Road, Silom, Bang Rak, opposite Robinson Bangrak. Saphan Taksin BTS is the nearest station; allow roughly a 3–5 minute walk from the station as a planning estimate. Use a live map for the final approach.
booking: No advance booking is needed for a casual meal; current listings show dine-in and takeaway. Call +66 2 234 3755 or +66 2 235 6324 to check hours or availability; these numbers appear in current restaurant listings.
accessibility: A tourism directory describes a two-storey, air-conditioned shop-house restaurant. Step-free access, accessible toilets and space for mobility devices are not confirmed; ask the restaurant before visiting if these are essential. One third-party listing marks the venue not wheelchair accessible.
practicalTips: Try roast duck with rice or noodles; red pork and crispy pork are also listed house options.
Carry cash as a backup; an older directory lists cash only, but current payment options were not confirmed.
Ask the staff about ingredients and cross-contact directly if you have food allergies; allergen procedures were not found.
Check the posted menu before ordering because online price information is incomplete and may be outdated.
This is a modest local eatery, so expect a practical setting and possible shared tables at busy times.
decemberNotes: No special December 2026 service or event was found. The restaurant appears to operate year-round, but holiday hours may change around Christmas and New Year; call shortly before visiting. Bangkok is typically hot in December, so a midday walk can still feel warm.
uncertainties: The restaurant's own current hours and December holiday schedule were not independently confirmed; listings differ by up to half an hour.
Current full menu prices and payment methods were not available from a primary source; quoted meal spend is an estimate.
Step-free access, accessible toilet provision, allergy handling and reservation policy remain unconfirmed.
The Commons image depicts a meal at Prachak in 2018 and may not represent current presentation.
